notes: Qwen3.8-27B Q8_0 with harness-hub/Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted, a rank-32 LoRA trained with RL to drive the pi coding agent (SWE-bench Pro hard-51 39.2% -> 64.7%, Terminal-Bench 2.1 39.5% -> 55.8% under pi, thinking off). The adapter is applied at run time by the dense engine (--lora: B (A x) beside each adapted projection, alpha / r = 2), from harness-hub/Qwen3.8-27B-pi-adapted-GGUF's F16 file: the base Q8_0 file is the same as Qwen3.8-27B-Q8_0.json's, untouched. Merging it into the Q8_0 weights does not work: the delta is under half a Q8_0 step for >99.7% of the weights and rounds away (docs/LORA.md). Thinking is off by default (the adapter was trained and evaluated without it; a request's chat_template_kwargs / reasoning_effort still turn it on), sampling is the training's (temperature 0.8, top-p 1.0). Same engine settings and drafters as Qwen3.8-27B-Q8_0.json; the drafters were trained on the base model, so their acceptance may be a little lower. pi: "api": "openai-completions" (docs/LORA.md).
